name: mochicode-auto
description: Keep Sol direct for normal work and add bounded workers, Manager Mode, or evidence gates only when their overhead is justified.

interface.longDescription: Preserves direct Sol High for normal work, uses Luna only for sizable independent leaves, and activates bounded Manager Mode for explicitly requested or genuinely long multi-phase projects. The Sol manager advances one receipt-backed phase at a time while deterministic state rotates failures, parks repeats, supports stop and resume, and permits one replan. Fresh verification remains risk-triggered, and the heavier controller remains experimental.
defaultPrompt: Complete this goal using the smallest quality-proven automatic route.
Keep stock Sol behavior unless a proven worker route clearly repays its overhead.
Use Manager Mode, a selective worker, fresh verification, or durable state only when its observable trigger is present.
